independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

visualChecks.check: Dark Welcome foreground and action emphasis
visualChecks.expected: The Welcome hero remains legible on the approved Dark surfaces, with New Drawing primary and Open Workspace secondary emphasis.
visualChecks.actual: The hero, supporting copy, primary action, secondary action, and Recent content remain clearly legible and preserve the approved emphasis hierarchy.

visualChecks.expected: Recent rows show only name and rootPath; drawing-count and last-opened metadata from the screenshot are omitted.
visualChecks.actual: Only name and rootPath are visible. The approved HF2-RECENT-COUNT-TIME omission is not treated as a mismatch.

visualChecks.expected: Top shell, Welcome body, action surfaces, Recent rows, and quiet footer remain visually distinct without adding legacy chrome.
visualChecks.actual: The fixed actual capture preserves the restrained Dark hierarchy and does not show a visible compositional regression.

compositionChecks.check: Compact Sidebar and Back controls remain at the far-left top shell layer
Welcome hero, two actions, Recent section, and non-persistent-state note are all present
Primary and secondary action emphasis is visually distinct and faithful
Recent section grouping and three-row stack preserve the frozen screen composition
The full Welcome shell is visible and no shell region is hidden by an SDK mask

legacyRemoval.control: large textual Pin or Unpin control
persistent normal-state All changes saved strip
Unicode placeholder tree or file icons

maskRationale: The immutable mask declaration contains no masks. HF2-05 Welcome exposes no SDK-owned editor, Library, or Presentation interior that requires masking, so the full shell capture was reviewed.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: ±2 CSS px; owned by the bound collector and not re-proved from the screenshot

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary welcome-screen component crop only

findings.expected: The frozen Welcome Dark hierarchy remains intact: compact shell controls, hero, primary and secondary actions, Recent section, three rows, and quiet footer.
findings.actual: The fixed actual capture preserves the hierarchy and grouping with no visible High or Critical mismatch.
findings.reproduction: Open the immutable actual.png at 1280x760 and compare it to the manifest-verified welcome-dark.png baseline, one image at a time.

findings.expected: Primary text, secondary text, action emphasis, row surfaces, and footer remain readable and visually ordered on the approved Dark palette.
findings.actual: The hierarchy is visually clear; New Drawing remains primary, Open Workspace remains secondary, and Recent rows remain distinct from the page background.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the fixed actual.png at native 1280x760 output size after confirming the collection theme is dark and fonts are ready.

findings.expected: Per approved deviation HF2-RECENT-COUNT-TIME, rows omit baseline drawing-count and last-opened metadata and show only name and rootPath.
findings.actual: Each Recent row shows only its workspace name and deterministic rootPath; the approved omission is accepted and is not masked.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the three Recent rows in the fixed actual.png and compare their visible field set to the approved deviation contract.

unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The recorded capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Behavior, persistence, keyboard operation, accessible names, focus-visible, reduced motion, loading, disabled, error, five-row overflow, Light/Dark geometry parity, token values, fonts, masks, and legacy counts were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable semantic collector owns those facts.
HF2-01 and the other four HF-2 screens were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-05.
nextGate: Proceed to T043 US2 Welcome regression evidence and then stop at the Phase 5 checkpoint; do not create an intermediate product-owner artifact or enter Phase 6.
